statement: At least one Russian air attack using missiles or drones causes an impact, explosion, or fire within Kyiv city between 2026-08-17 and 2026-08-31.
resolution: True if strikes on Kyiv city between 2026-08-17 and 2026-08-31 are reported by Ukrainian officials and by at least one Russian or non-Ukrainian international outlet.
failure_condition: No Russian missile or drone strike impacts Kyiv city between 2026-08-17 and 2026-08-31.

statement: Ukrainian drones or missiles strike a target at least 100 km from the Ukraine-Russia border inside Russia, causing fire, damage, or casualties, between 2026-08-17 and 2026-09-15.
resolution: True if Russian regional or federal officials acknowledge a Ukrainian drone or missile strike at least 100 km from the Ukraine border causing damage, fire, or casualties between 2026-08-17 and 2026-09-15.
failure_condition: No Ukrainian strike at least 100 km inside Russia causing officially acknowledged damage, fire, or casualties occurs between 2026-08-17 and 2026-09-15.

statement: Houthi (Ansar Allah) forces take control of central Marib city, Yemen, between 2026-08-17 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: True if at least two major international news organizations report Houthi forces control central Marib city by 2026-12-31, with Yemeni government or coalition sources conceding withdrawal or loss.
failure_condition: Central Marib city remains under Yemeni government control through 2026-12-31.

statement: ICE Brent crude front-month futures settle at or above 100.00 USD per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-08-17 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: True if the official ICE Brent front-month settlement price is at or above 100.00 USD on any trading day from 2026-08-17 through 2026-10-30, per ICE settlement data.
failure_condition: Every ICE Brent front-month daily settlement from 2026-08-17 through 2026-10-30 is below 100.00 USD.

statement: Walmart Inc files or furnishes a quarterly earnings release with the SEC between 2026-08-17 and 2026-08-28 reporting total revenue above the same quarter one year earlier.
resolution: True if a Walmart earnings release or 8-K on SEC EDGAR dated 2026-08-17 through 2026-08-28 reports quarterly total revenue above the prior-year quarter figure.
failure_condition: Walmart releases no quarterly results dated within the window, or reported quarterly total revenue is at or below the prior-year quarter.

statement: ASIC or another Australian federal agency announces enforcement or court action specifically citing deepfake or AI-generated celebrity investment scams between 2026-08-17 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: True if an official media release or court filing by an Australian federal agency, dated in the window, announces enforcement or legal action explicitly referencing deepfake or AI-generated celebrity investment scams.
failure_condition: No Australian federal agency announces enforcement or court action citing deepfake or AI-generated celebrity investment scams between 2026-08-17 and 2026-11-30.

statement: At least one US statewide ballot measure legalizing adult-use marijuana or establishing medical marijuana is approved by voters in the 2026-11-03 general election.
resolution: True if certified state results or AP race calls show at least one statewide adult-use or medical marijuana measure approved by voters on 2026-11-03.
failure_condition: Every statewide marijuana measure on 2026-11-03 ballots is rejected, or no such measure appears on any state ballot.

statement: A final rule transferring marijuana out of Schedule I of the Controlled Substances Act is published in the Federal Register between 2026-08-17 and 2027-01-31.
resolution: True if the Federal Register publishes a final rule in the window transferring marijuana out of Schedule I; proposed, interim, or delayed rules do not count.
failure_condition: No final rescheduling rule moving marijuana out of Schedule I appears in the Federal Register by 2027-01-31.

statement: Authorities announce the arrest or charging of at least one suspect in the 2026-08-15 Virginia State shooting in which five people were shot, between 2026-08-17 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: True if a law enforcement agency publicly announces an arrest or charges in the 2026-08-15 Virginia State five-victim shooting, reported by at least one national outlet, by 2026-09-30.
failure_condition: No arrest or charges connected to the 2026-08-15 Virginia State shooting are announced by 2026-09-30.

statement: USGS catalogs at least one earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater with origin time between 2026-08-17 and 2026-09-30 UTC and epicenter within 250 km of USGS event us6000tkt2 (the M7.7 near Ende, Indonesia).
resolution: True if USGS ComCat lists at least one magnitude 6.0 or greater event with origin time in the window and epicenter within 250 km of event us6000tkt2.
failure_condition: USGS ComCat shows no magnitude 6.0 or greater event within 250 km of event us6000tkt2 with origin time between 2026-08-17 and 2026-09-30.
